interaction_steps.prompt:
Do not edit tests. You are forbidden to modify protected files: "go.mod", "rename-plan.md".

Perform these 5 renames consecutively, possibly batched if you know how. Use rename-plan.md, update every call site, preserve behavior, and run go test ./... before finishing. Do not use semantic editing MCP tools; use standard file editing. When done, output DONE.

tool_calls.name:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
replacements = {
    'LoadInput': 'ReadRequest',
    'CheckInput': 'ValidateRequest',
    'NormalizeValue': 'CanonicalizeValue',
    'MapFields': 'ProjectFields',
    'RouteValue': 'DispatchValue',
}
for path in sorted(Path('pipeline').glob('*.go')):
    if path.name.endswith('_test.go'):
        continue
    original = path.read_text()
    updated = original
    for old, new in replacements.items():
        updated = updated.replace(old, new)
    if updated "'!= original:
        temp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + '"'.tmp')
        temp.write_text(updated)
        temp.replace(path)
PY
rg -n 'LoadInput|CheckInput|NormalizeValue|MapFields|RouteValue|ReadRequest|ValidateRequest|CanonicalizeValue|ProjectFields|DispatchValue' --glob '*.go' ."

/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- pipeline/processor.go pipeline/stage_input.go pipeline/stage_validation.go pipeline/stage_normalization.go pipeline/stage_mapping.go pipeline/stage_routing.go && git status --short -- pipeline/processor.go pipeline/stage_input.go pipeline/stage_validation.go pipeline/stage_normalization.go pipeline/stage_mapping.go pipeline/stage_routing.go go.mod rename-plan.md pipeline/*_test.go'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --untracked-files=no | head -50 && git show HEAD:pipeline/processor.go && cat pipeline/processor.go'
